qa_pair.question: Connect to the multi-agent team server. Browse its pre-built specialties catalog (the roles available for staffing agents). Exactly how many roles does the catalog contain? Answer with a single integer.

In the team server's role catalog, all but one role are curated copies of upstream community agent templates; exactly one role was authored brand-new for this product and records no upstream source in its provenance. Inspect the catalog and each role's provenance, then name that one net-new role. Answer with the role name exactly as the catalog lists it (lowercase-hyphen form).
Examine every role in the team server's specialties catalog and the target model each one declares. How many of the catalog roles target the "opus" model? Answer with a single integer.
Look up the "security-auditor" role in the team server's catalog. Which model does that role template target? Answer with just the model name.

Initialize the agent-team harness in a brand-new, empty project directory that has no prior team setup. Because the environment is net-new, the initialization response is supposed to include an implicit nudge to build project-specific Agent Skills before staffing the team. Does the team-initialization response include such a skill-forge nudge? Answer True or False.

Initialize the agent-team harness in a fresh project directory, then run the exact same initialization a second time on that same directory without changing anything. In the second run's structured response, what value is reported for the "netNew" field? Answer True or False.

Set up a fresh team, staff one agent, and have that agent claim a task whose ETA is two hours in the past (already overdue). Then run one manager maintenance pass. How many stale claims does the manager pass report? Answer with a single integer.

Set up a fresh team, staff a single agent, then retire that agent. This product never hard-deletes an agent — retirement archives it. After retiring the one agent, how many agents does the roster report as archived? Answer with a single integer.

Set up a fresh team and staff an agent using the "debugger" role. Then reassign that same agent to the "code-reviewer" role. After the reassignment, when you list the team, what role is that agent shown to hold? Answer with the role name.
Connect to the multi-agent team server and enumerate the complete set of tools it exposes over its protocol. How many distinct tools does the server provide? Answer with a single integer.
